# Music approach

**What role does music play?** · [all approaches](index.md)


## Quiet bed under the voice
<a id="quiet-bed"></a>

A low lo-fi or ambient bed about −22 to −24 dB, or 7–10 dB under the voice, for the whole reel.

**Looks like:** You barely notice it, but silence never happens. The voice sits on top, clean.

**Good at:** fills dead air; polish without distraction; teaching

**Weak at:** no trending-audio boost; generic if always the same track

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90, yt-short, yt-long · niches all · goals retention, trust · effort low

**How:** A CC0 or in-app track ducked under the voice in CapCut; mix to about −14 LUFS.

**Backed by:** [Quiet music bed near −22 to −24 dB](../topics/sound.md#sound-quiet-bed-throughout), [Mix measured at −14 LUFS](../topics/sound.md#sound-loudness-minus-14), [Broadcast voice: compress, de-ess, high-pass](../topics/sound.md#sound-broadcast-voice-chain), [Export silent; pick a low-use track in-app](../topics/sound.md#sound-low-use-count-track) · sources L01, L06, L10, R1, library

## Trending audio added in-app
<a id="trending-audio"></a>

A trending song chosen in Edits/Instagram at post time, ideally at the 'growing' stage.

**Looks like:** A vibe or transformation reel cut to a recognisable trending song; the audio page links it to thousands of others.

**Good at:** discovery; fits vibe and travel; zero mixing

**Weak at:** can't be baked into our renders; trends die in 7–10 days; doesn't fit talking reels

**Best for:** formats reel30, story · niches travel, gym · goals reach · effort low

**How:** Export silent, then pick the track in Edits; check its use count (under ~10K uses is ideal).

**Backed by:** [Trending audio only when it fits](../topics/sound.md#sound-trending-audio-fit), [Export silent; pick a low-use track in-app](../topics/sound.md#sound-low-use-count-track), ["You've probably seen X lately…"](../topics/hooks.md#hook-trend-riding), [Originality: no watermarks or near-duplicates](../topics/growth.md#growth-originality), [Three Instagram strategies](../topics/brand.md#brand-instagram-strategies) · sources SP, KH, research

## Music-led, cut to the beat
<a id="beat-synced"></a>

The music drives the edit: cuts, ramps and text land on beats.

**Looks like:** Every cut hits the kick, the top rep lands on the drop, and the text appears word by word on the beat.

**Good at:** energy; satisfying rhythm; montages

**Weak at:** poor fit for voice-led teaching; track licensing

**Best for:** formats reel30, yt-short · niches gym, travel, gaming · goals reach, shares · effort medium

**How:** Beat markers in CapCut/Edits; cut on markers.

**Backed by:** [Cut on the beat or on motion](../topics/editing.md#edit-cut-on-beat-motion), [Speed ramps: dead time, beats, top rep](../topics/editing.md#edit-speed-ramps), [Bass hit on every key text pop](../topics/sound.md#sound-bass-hit-text-pop), [SCORE and EMPHASIS lines per beat](../topics/sound.md#l10-storyboard-score-emphasis), [Half-second music dropout after the punchline](../topics/sound.md#l10-dropout-after-punchline) · sources SP, KH, L08, research, library

## Music changes by section, with dropouts
<a id="by-section"></a>

Different music per section (driving hook, lo-fi teaching, swell at the outro), plus planned dropouts.

**Looks like:** A driving synth under the hook, a half-second of silence after the punchline, then a softer bed while teaching, and a swell into the final line.

**Good at:** emotional shape; marks structure; punchlines hit harder

**Weak at:** more mixing; needs planning

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90, yt-long · niches all · goals retention · effort medium

**How:** A SCORE column in the storyboard; crossfade tracks in CapCut, or the real-sound skill.

**Backed by:** [Music changes by section](../topics/sound.md#sound-music-by-section), [Half-second music dropout after the punchline](../topics/sound.md#l10-dropout-after-punchline), [SCORE and EMPHASIS lines per beat](../topics/sound.md#l10-storyboard-score-emphasis), [Chapter sounds: risers, booms, set foley](../topics/sound.md#sound-riser-sub-boom-chapters), [Accordion: volume to learn, then effort](../topics/growth.md#growth-accordion-method) · sources L07, L06, L10

## Voice only, no declared music
<a id="voice-only"></a>

No trending track; the voice dominates (Rahul lists no track on any reel; L08's body has no bed).

**Looks like:** Just the voice, compressed and loud, maybe a faint room tone. Every word is clear.

**Good at:** clarity; no licensing issues; speed

**Weak at:** dry; no audio-page discovery

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90, podcast, yt-long · niches tech, all · goals trust, speed · effort low

**How:** Clean the voice (compress, de-ess, high-pass) and mix to −14 LUFS.

**Backed by:** [Voice-led, no trending audio](../topics/sound.md#sound-voice-led-no-trending), [Podcast body: long takes, demos as interrupts](../topics/editing.md#edit-podcast-long-takes), [Broadcast voice: compress, de-ess, high-pass](../topics/sound.md#sound-broadcast-voice-chain), [Sell a long video with a hyper-edited teaser](../topics/editing.md#edit-teaser-hyper-edited), [Export silent; pick a low-use track in-app](../topics/sound.md#sound-low-use-count-track) · sources R1, L08, library

## Mixing
A quiet bed plus a dropout after the punchline is L10's mix. Trending audio low under a voiceover is common in travel. Rahul likely runs a very low bed (inferred from the noise floor) but declares no track.

## Rule of thumb
Talking teaching: quiet bed or voice only. Vibe, travel and transformation: trending or beat-synced. Story arcs: by section.
